summary: Initialize the n>=2 adjacent-gap finite-reduction goal, exact definitions, open proof graph, obligations, and mechanism-distinct attempts.

node.title: Dirichlet weighted-string adjacent-gap box problem
node.statement: For R>1, K_R is the set of a.e. equivalence classes rho in L-infinity(0,1) with 1<=rho<=R a.e.; lambda_k(rho) are the increasingly ordered Dirichlet eigenvalues of -y''=lambda rho y on (0,1), and D_n(rho)=lambda_{n+1}(rho)-lambda_n(rho).

node.title: Bang-bang density and effective switch count
node.statement: A density rho in K_R is bang-bang with at most m switches when, after merging adjacent equal-value cells, it equals 1 or R a.e. on the cells of a partition 0=x_0<x_1<...<x_j<x_{j+1}=1 with j<=m.

node.title: All-n adjacent-gap parameter domain
node.statement: R is a real number with R>1 and n is an integer with n>=2.

node.title: Existence of adjacent-gap extrema
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, D_n attains its maximum and minimum on K_R.

node.title: At most 2n switching-function zeros
node.statement: For every rho in K_R, if u_n and u_{n+1} are weighted-L2 normalized consecutive Dirichlet eigenfunctions, then F_n=lambda_n u_n^2-lambda_{n+1}u_{n+1}^2 has at most 2n distinct zeros in (0,1) and no positive-measure zero set.

node.title: Every adjacent-gap extremizer is bang-bang
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, every global maximizer and minimizer of D_n on K_R takes only the values 1 and R almost everywhere, and every effective switch lies in the zero set of its F_n.

node.title: All-n finite-block reduction for adjacent gaps
node.statement: For every R>1 and integer n>=2, D_n attains both extrema on K_R, and every global maximizer and minimizer is bang-bang a.e. with at most 2n switches and hence at most 2n+1 constant blocks.

node.title: Weak-star compactness and spectral convergence imply existence
node.statement: Weak-star compactness of K_R and continuity of the relevant eigenvalues imply CLM-NGE2-EXISTENCE.
unresolved_obligations: Prove two-sided eigenvalue convergence under weak-star convergence of uniformly positive bounded weights.

node.title: Wronskian quotient monotonicity implies the 2n zero bound
node.statement: Sturm interlacing and a strict-sign Wronskian show that u_{n+1}/u_n is strictly monotone on each nodal interval of u_n, which implies CLM-NGE2-ZERO-BOUND.
unresolved_obligations: Prove the Wronskian sign on every nodal interval, including endpoint intervals.
Exclude positive-measure or accumulating zeros of F_n.

node.title: Box-constrained first variation implies bang-bang saturation
node.statement: The Feynman-Hellmann first variation, box-constraint needle variations, and CLM-NGE2-ZERO-BOUND imply CLM-NGE2-BANGBANG.
unresolved_obligations: Justify the derivative for arbitrary L-infinity directions.
Derive pointwise saturation from all admissible one-sided variations.

node.title: Existence, zero count, and saturation imply finite reduction
node.statement: CLM-NGE2-EXISTENCE, CLM-NGE2-ZERO-BOUND, and CLM-NGE2-BANGBANG imply CLM-NGE2-FINITE-REDUCTION.
unresolved_obligations: Show that switch points are a subset of the finite zero set and merge inactive adjacent cells.

node.title: Prove or refute the all-n finite-block reduction
node.statement: Determine whether CLM-NGE2-FINITE-REDUCTION is true in CTX-DEFAULT.
node.quantifier_contract: For every real R>1, every integer n>=2, and every global maximizer or minimizer rho_* in K_R, existence, bang-bang saturation, and the at-most-2n switch bound must hold.
boundary_cases: Measurable weights and weak-star oscillatory sequences.
The first and last nodal intervals and common Dirichlet endpoint zeros.
R approaches 1 from above, arbitrary finite R, inactive switches, and positive-measure switching-function zero sets.
completion_criteria: A content-hashed proof or refutation package has no unresolved obligations and passes independent definition, logic, boundary, and adversarial audits.
The approved proposal is merged and the post-merge trusted closure records the solved or refuted outcome.
non_completion_conditions: Finite scans, transfer-matrix experiments, or a theorem only for smooth or step weights do not count.
A stationary-point result, self-review, candidate proof, or unmerged proposal does not count.

node.title: Weak-star spectral continuity
node.statement: Prove the compactness and spectral-continuity step required by INF-NGE2-EXISTENCE.
node.formal_statement: If rho_j converges weak-star to rho in K_R, then lambda_k(rho_j) converges to lambda_k(rho) for every fixed k, and consequently D_n attains both extrema on K_R.
discharge_criteria: Give both limsup and liminf arguments without adding regularity to rho.
Handle eigenfunction subsequences and normalization explicitly.

node.title: Strict quotient monotonicity on all nodal intervals
node.statement: Prove the strict Wronskian sign and quotient monotonicity needed by INF-NGE2-ZERO-BOUND.
node.formal_statement: After orienting consecutive eigenfunctions consistently, W=u_{n+1}'u_n-u_{n+1}u_n' has one strict sign on (0,1), so u_{n+1}/u_n is strictly monotone on each component of {u_n!=0}.
discharge_criteria: Use interlacing to control every nodal-cell endpoint sign.
Include one-sided limits at 0, 1, and poles.

node.title: First variation and pointwise saturation
node.statement: Prove the Feynman-Hellmann and needle-variation steps required by INF-NGE2-BANGBANG.
node.formal_statement: At a box-constrained global extremizer, all admissible L-infinity directions give the correct one-sided derivative of D_n, forcing rho to saturate to 1 or R wherever F_n is nonzero.
discharge_criteria: Derive the eigenvalue derivative with the declared weighted-L2 normalization.
Convert integral variational inequalities to a.e. pointwise saturation.

node.title: Wronskian and nodal-knife route
node.statement: Attack the all-n zero bound by a strict-sign Wronskian and two level crossings per nodal interval.
node.method_family: Sturm separation, Wronskian sign, and quotient level counting
node.deliverable_contract: A complete all-n proof, a concrete counterexample, or the first exact sign gap with restart conditions.
falsification_tests: Random and designed high-contrast step weights for n<=8; inspect W and all F_n zeros.
node.expected_bottleneck: Endpoint cells and merely measurable rho.

node.title: Weak-star compactness and variational route
node.statement: Prove existence and bang-bang saturation directly in the full measurable box class.
node.method_family: weak-star compactness, min-max convergence, Feynman-Hellmann, and needle variations
node.deliverable_contract: Complete proofs of OBL-NGE2-WEAKSTAR and OBL-NGE2-FIRSTVAR or one exact remaining obligation.
falsification_tests: Rapidly oscillating weak-star sequences and directions supported on interior nonsaturated sets.
node.expected_bottleneck: Two-sided spectral convergence and derivative justification for L-infinity directions.

node.title: Adversarial all-n computation route
node.statement: Search for violations of the Wronskian sign, 2n zero bound, exact-switch conjecture, or symmetry conjecture.
node.method_family: transfer matrices, high-resolution zero counting, randomized and designed weights
node.deliverable_contract: A verified counterexample or bounded evidence with exact seeds, ranges, and limitations.
falsification_tests: Reject misindexed eigenvalues, grid-created zeros, and normalization artifacts.
node.expected_bottleneck: Completeness is unavailable; computation cannot prove the universal target.

node.title: All-n finite-switch literature route
node.statement: Search primary literature for exact quotient-monotonicity, bang-bang, or finite-switch theorems under the measurable box constraint.
node.method_family: primary-source search under alternate Sturm, string, and optimal-control terminology
node.deliverable_contract: An exact source theorem and symbol mapping, or a documented novelty map with limitations.
falsification_tests: Reject smooth-only, fixed-jump, ratio-only, or different-boundary results.
node.expected_bottleneck: Most nearby results impose smoother coefficients or optimize a different functional.
